Christmas trees and festive decoration

We deliver festive decoration for cities, squares, shopping centres and public spaces: concept, procurement, installation, safety and seasonal servicing.

Discuss a project See scope of work
The TPI LUX principle Built for the urban environment

Structures are engineered for the urban environment: stability, safe materials, durability and readiness for seasonal loads.

Scope of work

What this service covers

The outline is drawn from working material and presented here in the format of a commercial page.

City Christmas trees

Large frame and modular trees with decoration, integrated lighting and solutions for major squares.

Decoration concept

We study the space, select the decorative elements and prepare the visual idea for the festive setting.

Decorative elements

Large baubles, lighting elements, ribbons, themed ornaments and complete decoration sets.

Supply of structures

We procure for the project, arrange delivery, prepare the equipment and control quality.

Installation of the displays

Frame assembly, lighting installation, power connection, stability and safety checks.

Removal and storage

Removal after the season, packing, storage and preparation of the structures for the next period.

Solutions

Typical project components

  • tall city Christmas trees
  • frame trees with decoration
  • light arches
  • light tunnels

  • themed installations
Engineering accountability

Why TPI LUX

A complete approach to the project: concept, design, procurement, installation, commissioning and maintenance under a single responsibility.

The team works on large sites where deadlines, safety, quality control and clear communication matter.

Solutions are chosen for the site and for how it will be run, not only for how it looks on day one.
